sampleRecalls.title: LEGO Systems Announces Recall of Remote Controls Due to Burn Hazard
sampleRecalls.description: This recall involves Power Functions IR Speed remote controls sold separately and as a part of the Emerald Night Train kit (Item K10194) and Power Functions kit (Item K8882). The gray plastic remote controls have two large orange dials and the word LEGO printed on the front.
hazards: The batteries in the remote controls can overheat, posing a burn hazard to consumers.
injuries: LEGO Systems Inc. has received four reports of batteries overheating. No injuries have been reported.

sampleRecords.event_description: Fall on same level due to slip or trip
sampleRecords.final_narrative: An employee at an amusement park was helping a guest at an attraction when the employee fell to the ground, resulting in a fractured right forearm that required hospitalization.

sampleRecords.event_description: Struck by other falling object  n.e.c.
sampleRecords.final_narrative: An employee was preparing to begin work on the job site when ice fell from the canopy above and struck the employee on the head. The employee sustained a head injury.

sampleRecords.event_description: Fall to lower level from collapsing structure or equipment  less than 6 feet
sampleRecords.final_narrative: An employee was standing on a single-step stool to arrange merchandise on top of a shelf when the stool slipped out from under them. The employee fell to the floor and suffered a broken left femur.

sampleRecords.event_description: Compressed or pinched by shifting objects or equipment
sampleRecords.final_narrative: An employee was attempting to close a stainless steel garbage can door, which was stuck on a no-slip mat in front of it. The employee's right index finger was caught in the door, and her fingertip was amputated.

sampleRecords.event_description: Struck by object falling from vehicle or machinery-other than vehicle part
sampleRecords.final_narrative: An employee was moving stone slabs from a forklift to a stacked pile of stone in a yard. The slabs began sliding off the forklift supports, and the employee's fingers were pinched between two of them. The fingertips were torn off, and the fingers were crushed and torn open from the fingernail about halfway down the fingers; no bone was involved.
